item.title: Dear Abby: Treatment of elderly mother raises couple's hackles
item.description: DEAR ABBY: I have been happily married for 30 years. Unfortunately, my wife’s family (two older sisters and her mother, who is 97) have rejected not only me, but now my wife.

item.title: Get It Growing: Valentine's Day reminds gardeners to prune roses
item.description: Sharp pruners make clean cuts, which is important for efficiency as well as the plant’s healing process. LSU AgCenter/Randy LaBauve Valentine’s Day brings roses to mind, and for us gardeners, that’s a good thing — because this holiday serves as a reminder that it’s time to prune many of the roses we grow here in Louisiana.

item.title: Jeremy Alford and David Jacobs: How will cash flow thought the Senate race?
item.description: U.S. Sen. Bill Cassidy has been bragging about the record-setting war chest he has amassed for his reelection campaign and this week he put some of it to work with his first television ad.

item.title: John K. Flores: Winter's peak is perfect for birding
item.description: The Review/John K. Flores The northern shoveler drake in full winter/mating plumage is one of the most spectacular when it comes to seasonal colors, writer John Flores believes. This immature male vermillion flycatcher can be spotted at Burns Point boat landing. This golden-crowned kinglet was spotted at Brownell Memorial Park in Morgan City. There are nearly a million mid-continent lesser snow geese currently estimated in the state. Recent local temperatures have dipped into the low to mid 20s
